title: Can LLMs Hire Fairly? Racial Bias in Resume Screening

bias_targets.methodology: Paired-resume correspondence audit (counterfactual name substitution) evaluating LLM callback rates for fictitious resumes differing only by distinctively-Black and distinctively-White names.
Paired-resume correspondence audit (counterfactual name substitution) evaluating LLM callback rates for fictitious resumes differing only by gender-specific names.
